properties.Name: quickstart
properties.Note: 10 km box over Story County, IA (Ames). Story County is the densest corn-producing county in the US (USDA NASS) and is well-covered by OPERA RTC-S1 (~6 ascending acquisitions per month) and Sentinel-2 (~12 acquisitions per month). Chosen to exercise both ingest paths in a realistic agricultural setting.
